identification: Seven tall conical uranium (vaseline/yellow-green) glass goblets or vases with gummy gold-fleck (aventurine) knop stems, plus three uranium coupes with spiral-ribbed bowls, pink gold-fleck (aventurine) dolphin stems and ribbed feet. Venetian/Murano, probably Salviati or a similar Murano house, early to mid 20th century. No marks visible in photos; maker not confirmed. Uranium fluorescence photos (photo 2 and 3) show the glow.
marks_seen: No signatures, labels or etched marks visible; photos 2 and 3 are UV-glow shots of one coupe and one goblet.
